_comment: Phase D — 5 starter Structure recipes per STRUCTURE_DAMAGE_SPEC.md §7. Each recipe has a materialOf array (materialKey + qty) that the recipe engine consumes from a faction stockpile via game.bbttcc.api.factions.stockpile.adjust. footprintGrid drives token size. Special overrides: collapseProfile customization (e.g. Sept Bridge collapses at Damaged not Breached).

recipes.name: Sept Wall (1 segment)
recipes.description: Baseline mass fortification — quarried highland stone over an anchored foundation, blessed thread woven into the courses, a single yesodium course at the core. Holds when the sept does.

recipes.name: Bunker Gate
recipes.description: Canonical fortress entry — scribed-steel gate leaves, hex-glyph plates pre-engraved along the seams, foundation cores at the threshold.

recipes.name: Watchtower
recipes.description: Tall, sparse — ash-wood frame on mountain stone footings, hex-iron cleats anchoring the platform, a focusing lens at the top.
recipes.specialNote: +1 detection rolls in the containing Hex

recipes.name: Glyph-Ward Pylon
recipes.description: A single dense column of hex-glyph plates around a sept tuning fork, with a tree-of-life shard at the apex. Radiates a faint warding field.
recipes.specialNote: +1 ward resist to all adjacent Structures (stackable)

recipes.name: Sept Bridge
recipes.description: Stone deck over ash-wood lattice, cold-iron lacing, single foundation anchor at the midspan. Falls hard.
recipes.specialNote: Collapse fires at Damaged state — the ravine is the whole point
